scripts.check: svelte-kit sync && wrangler types && vp check && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm prose check && pnpm craftz check && pnpm test && pnpm build

hold.versions-typescript: svelte-check accepts TypeScript 5 and 6 only. Move when its peer range takes 7.
hold.cloudflare-config: cf can't deploy SvelteKit, since the adapter doesn't write cf's Build Output. Move when it does.
hold.toolchain-types: SvelteKit needs $app/types in types, and checkJs off, or svelte-check reads the Worker wrangler builds. Move when either changes.
